title: AI Agent 的算力成本怎麼算：把 GPU 拆成空間與時間
summary: 把成本結構完全不同的四個 AI Agent 放進同一個公式：GPU 拆成空間與時間，工作量依元件改用頁、分鐘或 Token，再把尖峰與離峰分開估算。
title_en: How to price AI Agent compute: split the GPU into space and time
summary_en: Four AI Agents with very different cost structures, one formula: split the GPU into space and time, measure work in pages, minutes, or tokens by component, and estimate peak and off-peak separately.

title: AI Agent 上線前要檢查什麼：把金管會六大原則變成一張九格表
summary: 把金管會六大 AI 原則拆成文件、產出、行為三層，乘上評估、紀錄、持續管理三問，變成一張可以留下證據、新專案也能沿用的九格檢核表。
title_en: What to check before an AI Agent launches: turning six FSC principles into a nine-cell table
summary_en: Split the six FSC AI principles into three layers (documents, output, behavior) and three questions (assessed, recorded, still managed): a nine-cell check that leaves evidence and that new projects can reuse.

title: AI 代理平台怎麼選：在採購前用實測找出 12 個問題
summary: AI 代理平台選型 PoC 的做法：依平台拆模組設計測試、先查 GitHub 的真實回報、用自己的法規 QA 實測、問題標嚴重度，再用同一張 42 項評分表比較。
title_en: How to choose an AI agent platform: 12 issues found by testing before purchase
summary_en: How I ran the platform selection PoC: tests designed per module, real GitHub reports reviewed first, the bank’s own regulatory QA as test data, a severity on every issue, and one 42-item scorecard for both platforms.

title: 從技術研究到產品：A2UI 的產品化旅程
summary: 用 A2UI 為例，整理把新技術推向產品的五個站點：商用場景、所需資源、價值驗證、PoC、產品化，以及為什麼順序不能反過來。
title_en: From technology research to product: the A2UI productization journey
summary_en: Using A2UI as the example, five stations that take a new technology to a product: use cases, resources, value check, PoC, and productization, and why the order matters.

title: AI 營運成效怎麼看：一張 Dashboard 回答「AI 值不值得」
summary: 整理 AI 營運成效 Dashboard 的指標框架：採用、品質、效益、成本、風險五個面向，以及對內 Copilot、Gemini 與對外 AI Agent 各自的資料來源。
title_en: How to read AI operations performance: one dashboard that answers "is AI worth it?"
summary_en: The metric framework for an AI operations dashboard: adoption, quality, value, cost, and risk, and where the data comes from for internal tools such as Copilot and Gemini and for external AI Agents.

title: 銀行的 AI 安全護欄怎麼做：從金管會原則到 3,600 題實測
summary: 整理我在銀行跟進金控 AI 安全護欄 PoC 時建立的框架：AI 治理三層、護欄四層防禦、政策順序、題庫設計、漏放率與誤擋率，以及護欄與紅隊驗證的分工。
title_en: How a bank builds AI guardrails: from FSC principles to a 3,600-case test
summary_en: The framework I built while following the holding company's AI guardrails PoC: three layers of AI governance, four guardrail layers, policy order, test-set design, miss rate versus false blocks, and how guardrails and red-team validation split the work.

title: 用 RAG 打造金融智能客服的踩坑紀錄
summary: 分享在 TEJ 實習期間，從零建構 RAG 智能客服系統的經驗，包括 Qdrant 向量資料庫的選型、chunk 策略的調整，以及如何讓 LLM 回答得更精準。
title_en: Lessons from building a RAG customer service bot for finance
summary_en: How I built a RAG customer service system at TEJ: choosing Qdrant, tuning the chunking strategy, and making LLM answers more accurate.

title: Multi-Agent 投資決策架構：讓 AI 像基金團隊一樣思考
summary: 如何用 LangGraph 建構多個 AI Agent 分別負責技術分析、新聞情緒、基本面研究，再透過辯論機制整合出投資訊號。
title_en: A Multi-Agent investment architecture: AI that thinks like a fund team
summary_en: How I used LangGraph to build Agents for technicals, news sentiment, and fundamentals, then combined them into a signal through debate.
